result.title: Final round of counselling for BE/BTech Admissions 2026-27
result.summary: The document announces the final round of counselling for vacant seats in the BE/BTech programs for the academic session 2026-27. This counselling will take place via Zoom on 14th August 2026. The detailed schedule will be available on the specified website on 13th August 2026, contingent on seat availability.
result.text:
Final round of counselling for BE/BTech  Admissions 202 6-27 
Dated: 1 0-Aug-2026 
The final round of counselling for the vacant seats, if any , in the BE/BTech programmes 
for the Academic Session 2026 -27 will be conducted through the Zoom platform on 
14th August 2026.  
The detailed counselling schedule will be uploaded on the website 
https://admission.thapar.edu  on 13th August 2026, subject to the availability of seats.  
 
REGISTRAR
